invoice_number.description: Unique invoice identifier or reference number

invoice_date.description: Date the invoice was issued (in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD if possible)

due_date.description: Payment due date (in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD if possible)

vendor_name.description: Name of the company or person issuing the invoice

vendor_address.description: Full address of the vendor including street, city, state/province, postal code, and country

customer_name.description: Name of the customer or company being billed

customer_address.description: Full billing address of the customer

line_items.description: List of products or services being billed

description.description: Description of the product or service

amount.description: Total amount for this line item (quantity × unit_price)

subtotal.description: Sum of all line items before tax

total_amount.description: Final total amount due including tax

payment_terms.description: Payment terms or conditions (e.g., Net 30, Due on receipt)

extract.system_prompt: Extract all data and translate it to English. If the original document is in another language, translate all text fields (vendor name, customer name, addresses, line item descriptions, payment terms, etc.) into English while preserving numerical values and dates.
